{
  "name": "pr-watch",
  "version": "0.14.0",
  "description": "Live pane tracking the GitHub PRs touched in a session: CI, review, conflicts, merge. One shared poller for every session on the machine.",
  "types": "./types/index.d.ts",
  "author": {
    "name": "eliraz-refael"
  },
  "repository": "https://github.com/ElirazKed/claude-code-pr-watch",
  "license": "MIT",
  "keywords": [
    "github",
    "pull-requests",
    "ci",
    "mod",
    "pane"
  ],
  "userConfig": {
    "poll_active_seconds": {
      "type": "number",
      "title": "PR poll interval while something moves (seconds)",
      "description": "How often GitHub is asked while a watched PR's CI runs or it is about to merge. Shared by every session on the machine; checked on a 10 s tick.",
      "default": 20,
      "min": 10,
      "max": 600
    },
    "poll_idle_seconds": {
      "type": "number",
      "title": "PR poll interval when idle (seconds)",
      "description": "How often GitHub is asked while no watched PR is moving. Shared by every session on the machine; checked on a 10 s tick.",
      "default": 60,
      "min": 10,
      "max": 3600
    },
    "update_notice": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Say when a newer pr-watch is out",
      "description": "Every 2 hours at most, the PR poll also reads pr-watch's version on GitHub (no extra request), and the pane's footer says when a newer one is out, with one toast per version. Off: never asked, never said.",
      "default": true
    },
    "layout": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Where the PRs show",
      "description": "pane: the PR pane, opened as PRs come (docked beside the transcript in a wide fullscreen terminal, else above the prompt). band: a few short lines above the prompt instead, most urgent first; the pane opens only when asked (Open pane, /pr-watch).",
      "options": [
        "pane",
        "band"
      ],
      "default": "pane"
    },
    "theme": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "How the PRs look",
      "description": "classic: round borders coloured by state. solid: borderless tiles tinted by state. minimal: no boxes, a thin rule between PRs. neon: bold vivid borders that glow on hover. retro: double borders in the 16 terminal colours. tide: each card fills like a glass as its PR moves on, behind a wavy front. aurora: each card a sky of soft northern lights in its state. Follows a light or dark Claude Code theme; /pr-watch theme <name> switches too.",
      "options": [
        "classic",
        "solid",
        "minimal",
        "neon",
        "retro",
        "tide",
        "aurora"
      ],
      "default": "classic"
    }
  }
}
